description: This file contains unit tests for the Result class in the org.openmrs.logic.result package, testing various methods such as earliest, latest, get, and toObject, primarily using JUnit 5 assertions.

classes.name: ResultTest
classes.description: Test suite for the Result class methods in the org.openmrs.logic.result package, ensuring correct behavior for result retrieval and comparison methods.

methods.name: toObject_shouldReturnResultObjectForSingleResults
methods.description: Tests that the toObject method returns the correct object when the result contains a single Result with a date and value.

methods.name: Result_shouldNotFailWithNullList
methods.description: Ensures that constructing Result with a null list does not throw exceptions.

methods.name: Result_shouldNotFailWithEmptyList
methods.description: Ensures that constructing Result with an empty list does not throw exceptions.

methods.name: Result_shouldNotFailWithNullResult
methods.description: Ensures that constructing Result with a null Result object does not throw exceptions.

methods.name: earliest_shouldGetTheFirstResultGivenMultipleResults
methods.description: Verifies that the earliest method returns the Result with the earliest date among multiple entries.

methods.name: earliest_shouldGetTheResultGivenASingleResult
methods.description: Checks that the earliest method returns the single result when only one is present.

methods.name: earliest_shouldGetAnEmptyResultGivenAnEmptyResult
methods.description: Verifies that calling earliest on an empty Result returns an EmptyResult.

methods.name: earliest_shouldNotGetTheResultWithNullResultDateGivenOtherResults
methods.description: Tests that null dates are handled correctly when determining the earliest result.

methods.name: earliest_shouldGetOneResultWithNullResultDatesForAllResults
methods.description: Checks behavior when all results have null dates; should return one of them.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueOnTwoEmptyResults
methods.description: Validates that two EmptyResult objects are equal.

methods.name: get_shouldGetEmptyResultForIndexesOutOfRange
methods.description: Ensures that requesting a result at an index out of bounds returns an EmptyResult.

methods.name: isNull_shouldReturnFalse
methods.description: Verifies that a newly created Result object is not null.

methods.name: latest_shouldGetTheMostRecentResultGivenMultipleResults
methods.description: Checks that latest method returns the result with the most recent date among multiple entries.

methods.name: latest_shouldGetTheResultGivenASingleResult
methods.description: Validates that latest returns the only result present.

methods.name: latest_shouldGetAnEmptyResultGivenAnEmptyResult
methods.description: Confirms that latest on an empty Result yields an EmptyResult.

methods.name: latest_shouldGetTheResultWithNullResultDate
methods.description: Tests that null dates are handled correctly when determining the latest result.

methods.name: toObject_shouldFailWhenContainsMultipleResults
methods.description: Ensures that calling toObject on a Result containing multiple sub-results throws a LogicException.
